notes.title: Darkblood Chronicles Updated to Version 2.1
notes.content:
Hi everyone, I've updated the game to version 2.1 which addresses the following:

- various minor unintentional bugs corrected
- various typographical errors corrected
- weakened Tepes & Revenant enemies in Sacred Remains
- weakened Malahyde Flesh boss
- weakened Caliph familiar
- strengthened Leo boss
- strengthened Samantha
- strengthened Aeon
- Creator familiar's Sacrament attack is no longer reflectable
- secret shop in Apartment now sells Love Potions & Poison Pills
- Poison Pill will reduce your relationship points to 0, making it easier to achieve all endings

If there's any questions, please feel free to shoot me a line. Thanks everyone.

Dorian T.
